Tribello is a regional American trick-taking game from Illinois, USA. It was contributed by Mary Beale, whose family from DeKalb County have played it since the 1930s or 1940s. The game is a whist-type quota game with four distinct rounds (cut trump, dealer names trump, no trump, and nullo).
Standard 52-card deck. Deal 4 hands of 13 (3 players + 1 pickup/widow).
13 cards each + 13-card pickup. Players exchange with pickup.
